messages:
Sam: Quick post-launch huddle notes — ran the 2-week signal review. We need to pick between bug fixes and a small UX lift for next two sprints. Summary: 4 customer regressions (streaming & rerank), 9 UX asks clustered around search field, 2 API contract clarifications.

Priya: Can you rank by customer ARR and severity? helps if we tie to comms windows.

Sam: Topline: customer X & Y are paying accounts (high ARR) and saw degraded latency on streaming. Rerank flip was a single high-sev for Z (on a contract). UX asks are many low-sev but high frequency.

Jen: Engineering quick take: streaming latency root looks like batching regression after last runtime tweak. Estimate: mitigation (config revert) 1 day, full fix 4 days. Rerank root maybe tokenizer parity mismatch  needs 3-6 days.

Leo: Product POV: customers with SLAs (X,Y,Z) must be P0s. UX wins are good for NPS but can wait for a patch release unless we have spare capacity.

Sam: Proposed decision flow:
- If customer ARR+SEV => immediate P0 patch + outbound comms
- If reproducible and quick mitigation exists => ship mitigation canary same day
- Otherwise schedule full fix next sprint

Priya: Agree. Also propose a parallel small UX patch if mitigation is <2 days and Eng can spare a dev. That gives us a visible patch for comms.

Jen: If we do the canary fallback, need telemetry alerts. @metrics-bot add: streaming_latency_fallback=true into dashboards and page if >3% error delta.

metrics-bot: Alert created: streaming_latency_fallback (threshold: 3% delta). Runbook: /runbooks/streaming-fallback.md

Sam: Action items (short):
```
- Jen: attempt config revert mitigation today, validate on canary
- Priya: draft customer comms for X/Y/Z (include ETA and rollback note)
- Leo: push UX patch branch to review if Jen has <2d spare
- Sam: update roadmap board: mark rerank fix as "blocker -> sprint A"
```

Jen: I'll attempt revert and report back by 16:00. If revert solves, we ship canary Fri.

Priya: If canary goes out, I'll coordinate a short note to affected customers and CS playbook. Keep language: "we identified and mitigated an issue affecting streaming latency".

Leo: UX patch: small change to placeholder + inline help. I can have a PR ready by EOD if Eng can allocate one reviewer.

Sam: Good. We'll meet tomorrow 10:30 to confirm canary result and lock sprint commits. Thanks all :raised_hands:
